summary.text: Kriss Wright is the Democratic candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Anna Scharf (R).
Wright is a research scientist who, in a Ballotpedia survey, described herself as chair of the Newberg Planning Commission.

paragraphs.text: Kriss Wright graduated from Miami Senior High School, earned an associate degree from Portland Community College in 1991, and received a bachelor's degree from Portland State University in 2006.
Her listed career experience includes work as a research scientist.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has served as a Newberg planning commissioner since 2019 and now chairs the commission.
Wright ran for the District 23 seat in 2022 and 2024, advancing from the Democratic primary each time and losing the general election to incumbent Anna Scharf both years.
She advanced from the Democratic primary again on May 19, 2026.

In her Ballotpedia survey, Wright listed protecting Oregon's water and water rights, opposing a new gas tax or tolls, and requiring complete design and cost analysis before the Oregon Department of Transportation commits funding among her key messages.
She also said she supports public safety, affordable housing, expanded health care and behavioral health services, and wildfire prevention and emergency preparedness.
